study: Secondary field tomography of the frozen L20 four-label posterior; not another primary preregistration, no critic, model search, acquisition or test-fold analysis.
codes: independently frozen, equally trained affine seed listed in affine/freeze.json
nonlinear posterior minus a lab-frame additive two-species-per-site template fit by ordinary least squares on cold training parents only
scope: The b2 candidate represents a different fit and is excluded here. All four probabilities, not MAP labels, logit magnitudes or random hard samples, are fields in the original common laboratory frame. Subtracting the additive template tests an observable not explained by this particular linear approximation, not conditional independence or many-body order.
projectors: O_h = O x inversion. Enumerate signed permutation matrices, factor improper elements as inversion times a proper rotation, use its permutation of four UNORIENTED body diagonals to identify the S4 cycle class. P_Gamma = dim/48 sum chi(g) f(g^-1 V). Signed labels and T1/T2 components are not averaged away before products. Check d^2 sum, character orthogonality, scalar/count, polar T1u, diagonal Eg and off-diagonal T2g quadrupoles, idempotence, mutual orthogonality and reconstruction on complete orbits of observed ternary blocks. Central projection separates isotypic subspaces, not individual copies or a unique vector orientation. Exact orbit orthogonality need not hold as an empirical inner product in fixed laboratory axes.
cohorts: Original validation partition at indices 9,7,0; index 7 warm transfer is descriptive. Sequential cumulative parent targets 64,128,256,512,1024,2048, only new cohorts measured at each stage. Four independent uniform complete periodic lines per direction family (axis, face diagonal, body diagonal) per parent; direction chosen uniformly in family. Every center on a line is used. Origin, ray, direction, physical source, training template and label orientation are common to every model. Independent packets of eight whole parents; all sites, sectors and temperatures retain their identities. A packet is the smallest uncertainty unit. Staged validation does not make reused historical archive parents independent external evidence.
separation: Trace and individual diagonal label covariances, E[X_i(x)(X_i(x+r)-X_j(x'+r))] with j the next parent in the same packet. Negative controls replace the positive arm by a second distinct parent. Signed C and (-1)^(sum displacement) C are the same measurement in two conventions, not independent tests. Width-three blocks overlap at step 1,2, are adjacent at 3, and have step-3 entirely unobserved Chebyshev layers for step>=4. Exclude Euclidean distances >= L/2, including ambiguous half-box lags. Contact separate. No negative variance clipping. No power-law or thermodynamic correlation-length fit.
angular: For all 13 unoriented cubic rays individually in fixed lab axes, measure connected covariance of every sector/label with even [n(+r)+n(-r)]/2 and odd [n(+r)-n(-r)]/2 archived A and B occupations. Radius steps 3,4,6 (respectively one, two, four empty visible-to-point layers) where |r|<10. Do not pool opposite lobes before measuring odd responses. These are signed observable response covariances, not a mutual-information or causal-response estimate.
spectrum: True 3-D S(k) = L^3 times connected E[F(k) F(k)*] for F(k)=box mean field times exp(-2 pi i k.x/L). Independent random-line panels estimate the two Fourier amplitudes on the same physical parent before taking the real cross product (no diagonal sampling floor); subtract cross-parent product. No magnitude squaring of a noisy single-panel estimate. Includes actual k=0, fundamental lab modes and staggered (10,10,10); noisy cross-powers may be negative. Nonzero-k and k=0 use the same normalization. Dense exact A/B fixed-composition k=0 connected variance is separately checked. No inference of a divergent susceptibility from one periodic box.
spectrum_calibration: On the identical archived centers and directions, calculate the two-panel spectrum of A and B occupations and compare to the exact dense periodic FFT on each corresponding whole parent for the same modes. Report the paired sparse-minus-dense discrepancy, not independent error bars on two estimators. The beta-zero canonical ensemble still has finite-volume anticorrelations from fixed composition; it is not an exact independence null.
controls: Posterior label masses, marginal and conditional entropy; separated shuffled-parent contrast; exact global composition spread; matched positive feature control at six axial steps: independently with probability 0.1 replace the readout of the archived distal A marker by the actual central A marker, without modifying a single configuration. Independently shuffle parents for the null. Report observed contrast to the unmodified distal feature, predicted 0.1*(contact minus actual distal covariance) and paired uncertainty. A plant validates estimator sensitivity, not physical correlations.
power: One precision target: index-9 axial step-6 connected covariance trace for the COMPLETE residual posterior, in squared-probability units. Approximate two-sided group-t intervals adjusted across six planned looks (alpha=0.05/6). Positive or negative comparisons elsewhere are exploratory; pointwise 95% intervals are descriptive and not multiplicity-controlled across the atlas. With >=256 parents/index stop for precision when adjusted half-width <=0.0005, the known signed plant is resolved and shuffled negative control is compatible with zero. Otherwise continue to 2048 or time budget. Report unresolved if interval spans zero, and whether effects as large as 0.001 are excluded; lack of power is not absence of a field. No long-range/criticality claim even when a tested separation is resolved.
cli: python examples/glass_autoresearch/sectors.py --data ~/datasets/lattice-glass/l20-16384-v1 --work /tmp/l20-sectors --out results/l20-autoresearch/sectors --round 0 --end-epoch 1795556725 ; then successive finite rounds 1..5 until stop. Checkpoint each complete packet; interrupted stages can resume the same round.
